release_notes: Version 1.0.5 adds profile delegation, an editable library graph, and agent evolution safeguards. It fixes private delegation persistence, context isolation, tool protocol handling, automation approvals, OAuth flows, and packaged WebUI assets, and tightens Gemini endpoint host validation against lookalike domains.
